headline: 1Password breach exposed customer names, emails, not passwords
summary: 1Password disclosed a data breach after an employee's corporate GitHub account was compromised and used to access backend systems, letting an attacker steal customer names and email addresses. The company said passwords and other vault data were not exposed, though affected users could face phishing risks.

claims.statement: 1Password disclosed a breach in which an attacker accessed an employee's account and stole some customer data, but not passwords.
